London Mayday Cannabis Action Program

12 Noon: The ‘End the Prohibition of Cannabis March’ assembles at 12 noon on Rush Common, beside Brixton Hill on Sudbourne Road, London SW2. The march departs at 12.30pm for Clapham Common, arriving there 1.30pm. Bring good humour, banners, drums, flags.

1.30pm - 8.30pm: A ‘Celebration of Cannabis Free Festival’, at Clapham Common, London. Tube: Clapham Common. Includes; speakers, Hemp Expo, cannabis medical clinic, poets, comedians, hemp ice cream, hemp beer, hemp fashion show, market, kids area, cake baking competition, raffle, debating tent. Everyone invited!

International Cannabis Coalition, PO Box 2243, London, W1A 1YF, UK. Voice: 0171 637 7467. Fax: 0870 054 8646. E mail: mayday@schmoo.co.uk Website: http://www.schmoo.co.uk/mayday.htm - introduction.

For more information (updated as often as we can) visit these pages:

MayDay World News - http://www.schmoo.co.uk/news.htm#Anchor1 MayDay UK News - http://www.schmoo.co.uk/london.htm MayDay Declaration - http://www.schmoo.co.uk/decl.htm Press Release March 22th 1999 - http://www.schmoo.co.uk/press4.htm What you can do - http://www.schmoo.co.uk/job.htm Full List of Coalition Supporters worldwide - http://www.schmoo.co.uk/support.

Resources: http://www.schmoo.co.uk/resorc.htm

The ‘International Cannabis Coalition’ seeks to; educate and communicate, change attitudes based on ignorance, and reach a rational political consensus, with the aim of urgently ending the prohibition of cannabis worldwide, using non-violent, legal and democratic processes only.

End the Prohibition - if not now - when?
